Wednesday Evening Rides

Grand Rapids, MI · Downtown · Social

Wednesday Evening Rides is a social group ride in Grand Rapids, MI. It rolls every Wednesday at 8:00 pm from Veterans Memorial Park. About 10–12 miles, casual.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Evening Rides group ride

A casual 10–12 mile roll through Grand Rapids streets for exploring, socializing and being seen on bikes. Usually ends with a drink at a bar. Bring a working bike, helmet and lights.
